top_signals.title: The Global Oil Glut Returns as High Prices Crush Demand
top_signals.summary: The global crude oil market is moving back towards oversupply, according to analysts from Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan, with demand destruction from high prices causing fears of a deficit to fade and concerns of a glut to rise. “We estimate the global oil market returned to a surplus of 1.1 million barrels per day ‌in September, widening to 1.4 million bpd in October, nearly matching last year's average of 1.3 million bpd,” JP Morgan said in a report this week. Goldman, meanwhile, saw the oil market as being balanced in both September…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Putin Transfers Japan Tobacco Assets to Local Firm in Latest Asset Seizure
top_signals.summary: Japan issued a demand for Vladimir Putin’s government to return the seized assets of Japan Tobacco Inc.’s Russian arm, the latest twist in an escalating diplomatic spat between the two nations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
